title: Phishing Email Analysis
description: Analyze a suspicious email and identify the phishing indicators. Look for red flags in headers, links, and content.
hints: Check the sender's email domain carefully
Hover over links without clicking to see the actual URL
Look for urgency language and grammatical errors
instructions: You've received a suspicious email claiming to be from your bank. Analyze the email and identify all the phishing indicators present. Submit your findings in the format provided.

title: Malware Signature Detection
description: Examine file hashes and behavior patterns to identify malware signatures in a sample dataset.
hints: Compare hashes against known malware databases
instructions: You have been provided with a set of file samples. Analyze their characteristics and identify which ones contain malware signatures.

title: Network Traffic Analysis
description: Analyze network packet captures to identify suspicious traffic patterns and potential data exfiltration.
instructions: Review the provided PCAP file and identify any malicious network activity. Document the source, destination, and type of attack detected.

title: Social Engineering Assessment
description: Evaluate a series of social engineering attempts and determine the attack vectors used.
hints: Look for urgency and authority manipulation
instructions: You will be presented with several social engineering scenarios. Identify the techniques being used and explain how to defend against them.

title: Cryptography Challenge
description: Decrypt an encoded message using various cryptographic analysis techniques.
hints: Look for patterns in the ciphertext
instructions: An intercepted message needs to be decrypted. Use your knowledge of cryptographic techniques to reveal the hidden content.

validation.answer: the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog

title: Web Application Security
description: Identify and exploit common web vulnerabilities in a sandboxed environment.
instructions: A test web application has multiple security vulnerabilities. Identify and document at least three different vulnerability types.

title: Digital Forensics Investigation
description: Conduct a forensic analysis of a compromised system to determine the attack timeline.
hints: Look for artifacts in temporary directories
instructions: A system has been compromised. Perform a complete forensic analysis and create a detailed incident timeline.

title: Spear Phishing Campaign
description: Analyze a sophisticated spear phishing campaign targeting a specific organization.
instructions: A series of targeted emails have been sent to employees. Analyze the campaign and identify the threat actor's objectives.

title: Ransomware Response
description: Respond to an active ransomware incident and implement containment measures.
instructions: An organization is under active ransomware attack. Lead the incident response and document your containment and recovery strategy.

title: Network Intrusion Detection
description: Configure and tune intrusion detection rules for a simulated network environment.
hints: Create rules for known attack patterns
instructions: Set up detection rules for a network segment and successfully identify the simulated attacks while minimizing false alerts.
